payment_attempts_succeeded_check.name: payment_attempts_succeeded_check
payment_attempts_succeeded_check.value: "payment_attempts"."status" <> 'succeeded' or ("payment_attempts"."observed_status" = 'successful' and "payment_attempts"."observed_amount_minor" = "payment_attempts"."amount_minor" and "payment_attempts"."observed_currency" = "payment_attempts"."currency" and "payment_attempts"."confirmed_at" is not null and "payment_attempts"."provider_reference" is not null)

payment_exceptions_resolution_check.name: payment_exceptions_resolution_check
payment_exceptions_resolution_check.value: ("payment_exceptions"."status" = 'open' and "payment_exceptions"."resolution_code" is null and "payment_exceptions"."resolved_at" is null and "payment_exceptions"."resolved_by_principal_id" is null) or ("payment_exceptions"."status" = 'resolved' and "payment_exceptions"."resolution_code" is not null and "payment_exceptions"."resolved_at" is not null and "payment_exceptions"."resolved_by_principal_id" is not null)

payment_obligation_events_actor_check.name: payment_obligation_events_actor_check
payment_obligation_events_actor_check.value: ("payment_obligation_events"."actor_type" = 'system' and "payment_obligation_events"."actor_principal_id" is null) or ("payment_obligation_events"."actor_type" = 'payer' and "payment_obligation_events"."actor_principal_id" is not null)
